definitions.explanation: The feeling of wanting to do something; motivation or eagerness to act.

examples.japanese: やる⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{何|なん}でも→何：00498_nani⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can do anything if you have the motivation.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- やる⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to get motivated)
- やる⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to not feel motivated)
- やる⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to summon motivation)
- やる⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちている→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧ (to be full of motivation)
- やる⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to be motivated)
- やる⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：noentry⟧ (to lack motivation)

USAGE:
- This is a casual/conversational term commonly used in everyday speech.
- More formal alternatives include ⟦{意欲|いよく}→意欲：05317_iyoku⟧ and ⟦モチベーション→モチベーション：06184_mochibeeshon⟧.
